RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday,  the December 7, 2007/Agrahayana 16, 1929 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Agriculture; Chemicals and Fertilizers; Consumer Affairs, Food
and Public Distribution; Health and Family Welfare; Micro, Small and
Medium Enterprises; Railways; Steel)
Total number of questions — 20
103
Breast feeding promotion measures
*321. MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
breast feeding is crucial for the health and
development of the infants and this holds
immense benefits for the mothers as well;
(b) whether lack of awareness on breast
feeding among the common people has been
the major bottleneck in promoting this
practice among the general public; and
(c) if so, what is the action plan of
Government to create awareness among the
general public about the immense benefits
of breast feeding?
Health sector expansion and health
care to old people
*322. SHRIMATI MOHSINA
KIDWAI: Will the Minister of HEALTH
AND FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
according to FICCI, India would require an
investment of 78 billion dollars in the next
decade to fund the addition of
approximately 10,00,000 beds which are
needed;
(b) if so, with meagre funding of 1 per
cent of GDP on total healthcare system,
how Government would achieve this target;
(c) what healthcare system his Ministry
is going to evolve for the ageing people and
senior citizens having chronic diseases; and
(d) in what manner, Government is going
to ensure that old age people get cheaper
and accessible medical treatment?
Renewal of Tatkal Scheme
*323. MS. MABEL REBELLO:
SHRI SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of RAILW AYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has renewed
the guidelines for the Tatkal Scheme for
reservations;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is a fact that reservations
under this scheme can now be obtained two
months in advance against the payment of
a premium;

104
(d) if so, the rationale for such provisions
in the scheme; and
(e) what steps are being taken to ensure
that the seats are made available to
passengers travelling in emergency?
Change in the route of trains
†*324. SHRI AJAY MAROO: Will the
Minister of RAILW AYS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the Government of
Jharkhand has expressed its displeasure by
objecting to the change in the route of
different trains or their cancellation by
Railways without taking the State
Government into confidence, in the name
of 'Bandh' of Maoists in the State;
(b) the basis of decision of cancelling of
trains or changing their routes; and
(c) at which level is the decision taken
in this regard?
Forceful occupation of seats in trains
by political workers
†*325. SHRI SHATRUGHAN
SINHA: Will the Minister of RAILWAYS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the workers
of various political parties freely travel in
the trains without tickets to take part in
the rallies being organized by the concerned
parties;
(b) whether it is also a fact that these
workers forcibly occupy the seats and
berths of the passengers travelling on valid
tickets and the Railway administration does
not provide any help to the passengers;
and
(c) if so, the action being taken in this
regard?
Failure of MCI to fill up
vacant posts
*326. SHRIMATI PREMA
CARIAPPA:
SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether after learning that the
Medical Council of India (MCI) has failed
to implement the directions to fill up the
vacant posts, the Delhi High Court has
directed Health Secretaries of eight States
and Vice-Chancellors of ten universities to
explain the reason for delay in implementing
the orders;
(b) if so, what were the reasons put
forward by the States for not complying
with the orders of the High Court to fill all
the vacancies in the Medical Council;
and
(c) what are the steps now being
considered to implement the orders of the
High Court to fill up all the vacancies?
Declining growth rate of
Agriculture
*327. SHRI RA VULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY: W ill the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the growth rate of
agriculture is declining;
(b) if so, the comparative details thereof
during the last three years alongwith the
reasons therefor; and
(c) the steps being taken to improve the
situation of agriculture in future?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

105
Special programme to check the
declining sex ratio
*328. KUMARI NIRMALA
DESHPANDE: Will the Minister of
HEALTH AND FAMILY WELFARE be
pleased to state:
(a) is there a steep decline in sex ratio in
India;
(b) if so, what are the special
programmes taken up by his Ministry to
change this trend;
(c) what are the main reasons for this
crisis; and
(d) what is the role assigned to NGOs
to set things right?
Decision to corporatise the Delhi
Milk Scheme
*329. SHRI SYED AZEEZ PASHA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has decided to
corporatise the Delhi Milk Scheme;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor; and
(c) the steps being taken in this regard?
Steel plants in Jharkhand
*330. SHRI ABANI ROY: Will the
Minister of STEEL be pleased to state:
(a) the details of MoUs signed for
setting up of steel plants in the State of
Jharkhand during the last two years and
how many projects have commenced, so
far, project-wise;
(b) whether the present or proposed
New National Mineral Policy is not
conducive to setting up of steel plants in
the States, as mining lease/iron ore blocks
are not allotted on time to the
manufacturers; and
(c) what steps Government proposes
to take to ensure that steel production does
not suffer on account of non-availability of
iron ore/iron ore blocks?
Production and procurement
of paddy
†*331. SHRI SATYA VRAT
CHATURVEDI:
SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION  be pleased to state:
(a) the total production of paddy in the
current season alongwith the details thereof,
State-wise;
(b) the quantum of paddy procured by
FCI;
(c) whether it is a fact that non-basmati
rice is not procured by FCI; and
(d) if so, the reasons therefor?
Incentives to farmers
*332. SHRI V ARINDER SINGH
BAJWA: W ill the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether any specific incentives have
been given to the farmers of wheat producing
areas this year so as to ensure increased
production of wheat in the country; and
(b) if so, the details thereof and the likely
expenditure incurred/to be incurred
thereon?
Survey for gauge conversion
†*333. SHRI KRISHAN LAL
BALMIKI: Will the Minister of
RAILWAYS be pleased to state:
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

106
(a) the number of proposals for rail-
tracks on which survey work for gauge
conversion, has been included in the Rail
Budget for the year 2007-08;
(b) the time limit fixed for completion
of the survey work of the above gauge
conversion; and
(c) the criteria fixed for approval of
gauge conversion work on completion
of survey work?
Synthetic milk production in Uttar
Pradesh
*334. SHRI AMIR ALAM KHAN:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that a
large quantity of synthetic milk and its
products are being prepared by
unscrupulous manufacturers by mixing
detergents, urea and shampoo in and around
Bulandshahar, Saharanpur, Muzaffarnagar
and Meerut;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the number of persons booked under
the law and convicted for the adulteration
of these products; and
(d) the action taken by Government to
contain this illegal trade which played havoc
with the life of the consumers?
Primary Health Centre at Nandla
*335. SHRI MATI VIPLOVE
THAKUR: Will the Minister of HEALTH
AND FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there is no
Primary Health Centre in village Nandla of
Shimla District of Himachal Pradesh;
(b) whether it is also a fact that in the
absence of adequate health facility,
approximately 1000 members of
population of the village is forced to walk
nearly 10 kilometres to get health facility;
and
(c) if so, the steps being taken to provide
Primary Health Centre at Nandla?
New Catering Policy
*336. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will
the Minister of RAILW AYS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government has formulated
a New Catering Policy in Railways;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the number of new agencies to which
catering contracts have been awarded
during the last three years, year-wise,
together with the terms of the contracts
and the procedure to be followed in this
regard;
(d) the number of new catering stalls
allotted during the last three years and the
train numbers in which they are expected
to be provided, zone-wise;
(e) whether the Kaifiyat Express train,
Delhi-Azamgarh-Delhi shall be provided
with this facility and if so, by when;
and
(f) the steps taken to keep the prices of
food items reasonable?
Increasing the allocation of rice to
Mizoram
*337. SHRI LALHMING LIANA: Will
the Minister of CONSUMER AFFAIRS,
FOOD AND PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware of the
crisis of food security in Mizoram and the
gravity of famine situation in that State;

107
(b) whether Government has received
any appeal from the Government of
Mizoram to enhance allocation of APL/
BPL/AAY rice to save the people of
Mizoram from starvation; and
(c) if so, whether Government proposes
to solve this problem by conceding the
appeal of the Government of Mizoram,
and the time frame for enhancement of
allocation alongwith the action taken
thereon, so far?
Passenger growth pattern in main
routes in Andhra Pradesh
*338. SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA:
Will the Minister of RAILWA YS be pleased
to state:
(a) what is the average number of days
that a passenger must book a ticket for AC
accommodation in Godavari Express in
advance in Andhra Pradesh;
(b) whether it is a fact that 20 days
advance booking is needed to confirm an
AC berth for the Godavari Express from
Secunderabad station;
(c) to what extent Government has
made any study of passenger demands for
important trains like the Godavari Express,
Gowthani Express, Norzapur Express and
Charminar Express in Andhra Pradesh;
and
(d) the steps proposed to get an outside
agency to study passenger growth pattern
on main routes in Andhra Pradesh?
Shortage of fertilizers
†*339. SHRIMATI MAYA SINGH:
Will the Minister of CHEMICALS AND
FERTILIZERS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
especially in Northern India the rabi season
extends from October till December
wherein water and fertilizers have special
importance;
(b) whether it is a fact that Government
is not able to supply urea and DAP;
(c) the steps being taken by
Government to supply urea and DAP and
by when these fertilizers would be made
available; and
(d) the reasons for not providing
fertilizers on time and the names of the
States where adequate supply of  fertilizers
is not being made?
Side effects of medicines
†*340. SHRI RUDRA NARAYAN
PANY:
SHRI SHREEGOPAL VYAS:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the cases of new problems
being caused by the regular use of allopathic
medicines are increasing;
(b) whether interest of the people
towards Ayurvedic and Y oga has increased
during the last two years and if so, the
percentage of increase in these systems
estimated; and
(c) whether Indian Homoeopathic
Organisations have given any information
to Government on the observation on
Homoeopathy made recently in foreign
countries?
N
EW DELHI; V . K. AGNIHOTRI,

Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased to
state:

the National Horticulture Mission in the
